title: Neighborhood Booming
text: A trendy district sprang up around your home — values are soaring.

choices.label: Refinance and cash out
choices.log: You pulled equity out at the top of the market.

choices.label: Just enjoy the equity
choices.log: Your home is worth a fortune now. Nice.

title: Burst Pipe
text: A pipe bursts overnight and floods your ground floor.

choices.label: Call an emergency plumber
choices.log: Pricey, but fixed fast.

choices.label: Try to fix it yourself
choices.log: You grabbed the toolbox.

outcomes.log: You actually fixed it! Saved a fortune.
You made it worse. The repair bill doubled.

title: Break-In
text: You come home to a smashed window — you've been burgled.

choices.label: File an insurance claim
choices.log: Insurance covered most of it, eventually.

choices.label: Install a full security system
choices.log: Cameras everywhere now. You sleep easier.

title: HOA Dispute
text: The homeowners' association is fining you over the color of your front door.

choices.label: Pay the fine and repaint
choices.log: Not worth the fight. You repainted.

choices.label: Fight them at the next meeting
choices.log: You showed up ready to argue.

outcomes.log: You won — and got half the rules changed!
You lost, and they doubled the fine.

title: Renovation Project
text: You're thinking of renovating to boost your home's value.

choices.label: Gut and remodel the kitchen
choices.log: Big spend on the reno.

choices.label: Just a fresh coat of paint
choices.log: Cheap and cheerful refresh.

title: Nightmare Tenant
text: A tenant in one of your rentals has stopped paying and trashed the place.

choices.label: Begin eviction proceedings
choices.log: Slow and costly, but you reclaimed the unit.

choices.label: Offer cash-for-keys to leave quietly
choices.log: You paid them to go. Painless, at least.

title: Model Tenant
text: A tenant has paid early every month and even fixed up the yard.

choices.label: Reward them with a small rent freeze
choices.log: Loyalty over greed. They'll stay for years.

choices.label: Raise the rent anyway
choices.log: More income, but it stings your conscience.

title: Flip Opportunity
text: A run-down property hits the market cheap — a classic flip.

choices.label: Buy, renovate, and resell
choices.log: You took the plunge on the flip.

outcomes.log: Flipped it for a huge profit!
Sold at a small loss after delays.

choices.label: Too risky — pass
choices.log: You let this one go.

title: Squatters
text: Squatters have moved into a vacant unit you own.

choices.label: Hire a lawyer to remove them
choices.log: Legal route. Expensive but clean.

choices.label: Negotiate with them directly
choices.log: You knocked on the door to talk.

outcomes.log: They left peacefully for moving money.
It turned hostile. You had to call the police.

title: Property Tax Hike
text: The city just reassessed your area — your property taxes are jumping.

choices.label: Appeal the assessment
choices.log: You filed an appeal.

outcomes.log: Appeal granted — you saved on the bill.
Denied. You paid the higher rate.

choices.label: Just pay it
choices.log: You grumbled and paid up.
